### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">2017 is most recent guidelines, and they are being updated this year (2026). G6PD testing (quantitative) will be included as a recommendation in the new guidelines. There are plans to roll out the STANDARD G6PD test at the district health centre level, after a pilot in the community showed that community testing was not possible. According to the NSP, phased implementation is planned.</div>
